text:
Dear Hiring Team at Skyward Logistics,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the DevOps Engineer position. With a background in backend development and cloud deployment, I am eager to contribute my technical skills to your infrastructure team. 

During my recent internship at Ledgerly Payments, I built REST APIs in Java 17 and Spring Boot, optimized PostgreSQL queries and Flyway migrations, and reduced the slowest report time from nine seconds to 1.2 seconds using indexes. Additionally, I handled on-call rotation duties for two months and gained hands-on cloud experience by deploying a library management system on AWS EC2. I also developed a URL shortener in Go with Redis caching, which was load-tested to 2,000 requests per second. 

While my resume highlights a strong foundation in Java, Go, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, Kafka, and Linux, I am keen to further develop my expertise in infrastructure automation tools like Terraform, Kubernetes, and ArgoCD as required by your team. 

I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my software engineering background aligns with the DevOps Engineer role at Skyward Logistics. Thank you for your time and consideration.

Sincerely,

Alex Rao
